proposals.title: Identity/FP/materiality registry
proposals.scope: kind별 identity projection, rejection key scope, materiality 판정 필드와 domain-specific duplicate 순서. 수치 tolerance 값은 별도 평가.

proposals.title: Effective edge와 dependency contract
proposals.scope: EffectiveEdgeRef, 최신 negative 우선, pending/unknown, 실제 endpoint 소비 의존성. semantic EdgeRevision 없는 rebasing 유지.

proposals.title: Propagation completion receipt
proposals.scope: 의무 dependency revalidation과 discovery 구분, watermark/coverage/미완료 obligation 기준 quiescence. hard propagation cap 없음.

proposals.title: 현재 support와 material evidence state
proposals.scope: creation provenance와 current support receipt 분리. no-material 재검증 후에도 새 support/dependency 보존.

proposals.title: Atomic commit/retry/publication barrier
proposals.scope: read-set freshness, execution/proposal 분리, outbox/lease/fan-in, replacement-set publication, commit ordering.

proposals.title: Operation/effect/subtype registry
proposals.scope: 정보 기반 K revalidation public subtype 이름, effect-only 승인 표현, N2E predicate 변경 처리, DAG 범위. 정확한 이름은 승인 과정에서 선택.

proposals.title: Evidence independence와 생성물 lineage
proposals.scope: source work/study/derived origin metadata, leaf support dedup, P/B 재수입의 authority/독립 근거 세탁 방지.

proposals.title: Decision command와 Wisdom retrieval 축
proposals.scope: confirmation-event idempotency, payload binding, action mapping, temporal supersession, reported trace, evidence mode/strategy 분리.

proposals.title: Read snapshot/projection/replay
proposals.scope: effective state projection key, authoritative filtering, index watermark, historical read receipt와 재실행 한계.

proposals.title: Storage/security/operational controls
proposals.scope: file/DB publish/reconciliation, trust boundary, secret/privacy/backup, 명시적 pause/resume/cancel과 partial 상태.

proposals.title: 본문 편집 잔재 정정
proposals.scope: 충돌 문장을 승인된 규칙에 맞춰 정정. 원본 archive는 그대로 보존하고 승인 overlay에 정확한 replacement를 기록.

proposals.title: 실제 repository 기반 구현 profile
proposals.scope: U01–U03(CLI-first/GUI-last, MinerU PDF, 영어 구성요소명)는 확정. 실제 repo 언어/toolchain/CLI library/MinerU version-backend/DB-test profile만 조사 후 확정. GUI framework는 T13 전까지 채택 금지.
